name: Mamiya Maiko
source:
A school nurse who was transferred this year.

She has a bright, straightforward and open personality.

She always wears revealing clothes, but she is an Aikido black belt and has a strong sense of justice.

She may appear to be a joker, but she has a strong sense of justice and dislikes crooked things.
